items.q: a fellow by the name of Thigpen trumpet player

ctx.x: And George Stevenson, a fellow by the name of Thigpen trumpet player, Maddox Pigeon, a good one, too. A very good one. And Max Merritt ... Saxophone section was... I can't remember everybody. That's a long time ago, Stan.
Yeah. Well, this is before the band with Chu Berry and Roy in it?
